title: The part number warning says 1 other location, or nothing for one location
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin who can switch between two locations: the test location and location B.
  • Have a part, part B, at the test location and at location B under the same part number.
  • Have a part, part C, at the test location only.
  • Start on the Inventory page (Parts in the top bar, then Inventory in the left menu), on the Active tab.
custom_steps:
1. Type part B's part number in the Search box.
  2. Click the part B row.
  3. Click at the end of the Part Number.
  4. Type X.
  5. Click Cancel.
  6. Type part C's part number in the Search box.
  7. Click the part C row.
  8. Click at the end of the Part Number.
  9. Type X.
  10. Click Cancel.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Part B is listed.

Step 2:

  • Edit Inventory Part opens for part B.

Step 3:

  • The cursor is at the end of the part number.

Step 4:

  • Under Part Number: "This also changes the part number at 1 other location." (location B).

Step 5:

  • The window closes without saving.

Step 6:

  • Part C is listed.

Step 7:

  • Edit Inventory Part opens for part C.

Step 8:

  • The cursor is at the end of the part number.

Step 9:

  • No message shows under Part Number, because part C is stocked at no other location (part B's window showed one for the same change).

Step 10:

  • The window closes without saving.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, version 33 (23 Oct 2026, owner Chris Ward), read 27 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10647, story SV-10826 (Story 13, The Part Dialog)

  • S13-R16: “When the user changes the part number and at least one other location stocks the same Part Library entry, the dialog shows, under the field, "This also changes the part number at {n} other locations.", or "This also changes the part number at 1 other location." for one.”
  • User Feedback Summary: “Part number changed on a part other locations stock | "This also changes the part number at {n} other locations." ("1 other location." for one) | Text under the field while it differs”
